attrs.evidence: R5.2 had one field doing two jobs. Fable proposed that an open rebutting defeater should make PROVED impossible; GPT-5.6 refused that and it was right — a machine-checked proof does not become invalid because someone recorded an unresolved objection, and the honest reading is PROVED / contested. §9 derives the state from the attack graph and writes nothing back. Three PROVED claims currently read as contested or undermined, which is information the artifact could not previously express at all.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6 adjudication §6: truth status, assurance state and promotion admissibility are three objects, not two.
attrs.statement: A claim carries two independent labels: its `status`, which is what the ledger says about the proposition, and its DERIVED assurance state, which is what the current graph says about the support. Neither may overwrite the other. An open rebuttal makes a claim contested; it does not make a checked theorem stop being proved.
